changelog: After updating to 3.2.121, click Update Now once more. Updates run the previously installed update script, and only the 3.2.121 script refreshes the remote agent package — the second run applies it.

Updates now refresh the remote agent package. "Install agent" and the install command send /opt/urbackup-gui/agent to remote hosts, and updates never refreshed it, so updated installs kept shipping the agent they were first installed with. On 3.2.120 that agent failed with tsc: not found and set up no certificate, which the 3.2.120 backend requires.
Updates now copy VERSION as well as version.json.
